<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:3">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> top <he>זבנין ליה … מחד סיר׳</he> they bought for him (R. R. s. 3</cite>, in Hebr. dict.: <cite ref="J00695"><he>ישמעאלי</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>סַרְקָאִין</he>, <he>סַרְקָאֵי</he>, <he>סַרְקָיִין</he>.
